title: Senior Radar Systems Engineer - Defense & Space Manufacturing

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Radar Systems Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: The Senior Radar Systems Engineer will support our subsidiary located in [Location masked]. We support DoD and [Location masked] customers by planning, implementing, and testing systems and software for advanced radar and threat simulator systems. We specialize in the development of advanced radar systems and radar related products for the Department of Defense and other U.S. Government agencies. Our radar programs involve all phases of development from requirements generation through hardware and software design, fabrication, integration, and test.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Active Department of Defense (DoD) Secret security clearance.
BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or Physics.
Experience in radar systems, including: Radar and radar-related concepts such as the Doppler effect, detection theory, tracking, digital signal processing (FFT, IIR/FIR filtering, etc.), waveform generation, receiver design, and antenna theory.
System-level and/or subsystem-level requirements and specifications.
Systems integration and test.
Use of MATLAB for analysis or simulation.
Preferred Requirements
Expert level proficiency in MATLAB.
Familiarity with RF, analog, digital, or microwave hardware design.
Use of test equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, etc.
Familiarity with software development, C++, and Linux operating systems.
MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Systems Engineering.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

We support DoD and [Location masked] customers by planning, implementing, and testing systems and software for advanced radar and threat simulator systems. We specialize in the development of advanced radar systems and radar related products for the Department of Defense and other U.S. Government agencies. Our radar programs involve all phases of development from requirements generation through hardware and software design, fabrication, integration, and test.
cond_0291.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Active Department of Defense (DoD) Secret security clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Background in radar systems, including concepts such as the Doppler effect, detection theory, tracking, digital signal processing (FFT, IIR/FIR filtering, etc.), waveform generation, receiver design, and antenna theory.
Working knowledge of MATLAB for analysis or simulation.
Experience with system-level and/or subsystem-level requirements and specifications.
Experience with systems integration and test.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with RF, analog, digital, or microwave hardware design.
Experience with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, etc.
Comfort with software development, C++, and Linux operating systems.
MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Systems Engineering.

System-level and/or subsystem-level requirements and specifications.

Familiarity with RF, analog, digital, or microwave hardware design.

Familiarity with software development, C++, and Linux operating systems.
MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or Systems Engineering.
